svg.aria-label: Synthetic demo: the terminal board shows agents’ progress and Codex’s question. The web board has a Settings button and can send to a connected Codex session.
svg.font-family: 'Inter', 'Noto Sans TC', 'Noto Sans SC', -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang TC', 'Microsoft JhengHei', sans-serif
svg.title: Agent Board: Synthetic demo: the terminal board shows agents’ progress and Codex’s question. The web board has a Settings button and can send to a connected Codex session.

g.text: Each one reports in by itself,
so you stop checking each window.
Each step shows up the moment
The agent that needs you comes first,
Open Settings at the foot of the page
to change the language or theme.
Write to a connected Codex session.
Its confirmation shows it was received.
On a fresh install, answer yes
